summary.name: Writesonic
summary.one_liner: Writesonic is an AI search growth platform that tracks brand visibility across AI answer engines, recommends content and technical fixes, and measures the resulting traffic and revenue lift.
use_cases: track how often a brand appears in AI answers
find prompts where competitors are mentioned instead
prioritize content and citation fixes for AI search
measure traffic and pipeline lift from AI search work
manage AI visibility for multiple client brands
optimize product visibility in ChatGPT Shopping
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a platform that tracks brand visibility across 8 AI platforms, showing sample results such as a brand's AI visibility rising from 12% to 71% across 100 tracked prompts. It has a Prioritize step that ranks opportunities like missing prompts, citation gaps, new content topics, page refreshes, and technical issues. An Act step covers execution, including content and external mentions, and a Prove step measures each fix at Day 14 and Day 28 for citation share, AI traffic, conversions, and pipeline. It also lists enterprise features (multi-brand tracking, approval workflows, 50+ languages), agency features (white-label reporting, multi-client management, pitch workspace), and integrations with Google Analytics, Search Console, Looker Studio, Keyword Planner, WordPress, APIs, and MCP.
notable: AI Search Loop: prioritize, act, measure, repeat workflow
Day 14 and Day 28 measurement of each fix
Agency features including white-label reporting and pitch workspace
caveats: Enterprise, agency, and commerce features are described without stated prices on the page
Page marketing claims (such as customer switching and a 12% to 71% visibility jump) are vendor-presented examples, not independent results
Free trial is described as 7 days with no credit card; ongoing free tier details are not stated
